mechanism: componentDidMount reads navigator.connection.effectiveType (or moz/webkit-prefixed equivalents) and renders a distinct, minimal 'slow network' view in place of the normal product shelf when effectiveType contains '2g'.

notes: Undocumented in README.md or the dashboard (source-only finding); a controllable, deterministic condition once the intended DevTools-protocol mechanism for setting effectiveType is used. Engine caveat: the Network Information API (navigator.connection / .mozConnection / .webkitConnection) is Chromium-only; on WebKit (Safari) and Firefox none of the three are defined, is2gConnection evaluates to its `false` fallback, and the app always renders the normal shelf regardless of actual network speed -- so this specific mechanism is reachable only via a Chromium-based automation driver (e.g. Playwright/Selenium on Chrome or Edge), not a structural limitation of the finding itself.
